title: Multimodal and vision-based exploits
ports_note: This lab does not serve. Port 8004 stays unallocated.
interaction: beginner (10 guided typed commands, two attacks) or expert (real shell + nano + craft.py + stamp_gate.py --tune)

models.shared_note: SHARED with labs 3 and 5-7. Bought by lab 3; lab 4 reuses it and buys no model of its own.

measured.resists_numeric_policy: 0/12 - four payload styles could not talk it past an arithmetic limit

models.reproducible_layer: fetch_assets.py pins the model's mtimes and deletes the hub cache metadata, but MEASURED: that is not sufficient. Two no-cache builds of this Dockerfile still differ on every file-adding layer, because BuildKit stamps added files with the build time. So a student who already pulled lab 3 re-downloads the 1.12 GB model for lab 4. Fixing it needs a course-wide decision (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH + rewrite-timestamp, a published base image carrying the model, or the 8-lab consolidation, which stores it once anyway).

models.source_id: trained at build time by scripts/stamp_gate.py
models.shared_note: Lab-4 only. Nothing is downloaded: 800 synthetic stamps are rendered and the model is trained in numpy in ~36s at build time.

measured.min_perturbation: 7/255 (2.7% of the brightness range) flips it to ORIGINAL
measured.random_control: 0 of 30 random perturbations of the same magnitude flipped it

python_packages.name: llama-cpp-python
python_packages.note: NO PyPI wheels - source build. Multi-stage, ~90s compile, 134 MB runtime. Build with CMAKE_ARGS=-DGGML_NATIVE=OFF.

python_packages.name: pillow
python_packages.note: New in lab 4. Renders the invoices at build time, applies the perturbation at run time. 29 MB installed.

apt_packages.name: libgomp1
apt_packages.note: REQUIRED. libllama.so links against OpenMP; without it the import dies with 'libgomp.so.1: cannot open shared object file'.

apt_packages.name: tesseract-ocr
apt_packages.note: New in lab 4, own layer. 89 MB with -eng and fonts-dejavu-core, minus 10 MB for osd.traineddata which is deleted in the same RUN (only --psm 0 uses it).

apt_packages.name: fonts-dejavu-core
apt_packages.note: Needed at RUN time as well as build time: expert mode re-renders the attack image from the student's own payload.

lab_assets.note: Rendered deterministically by make_invoices.py --bake. Not stored in git.
The clean/attack pixel difference, compressed. 1.6 MB raw, 6.9 KB compressed. The attack image itself is deliberately NOT shipped - the student reconstructs it.
160x160 DUPLICATE stamp crop, rendered deterministically by stamp_gate.py.
FGSM perturbation against the stage 1 gate, 7/255. The attack stamp is not shipped; the student builds it.
Logistic regression over 25,600 pixels, trained at build time on 800 synthetic stamps. No download, no torch.

not_used.name: torch
not_used.reason: llama.cpp runs the model. The vision side of this lab is OCR, not a neural encoder. Adding torch back would cost ~250 MB for nothing.

not_used.name: transformers
not_used.reason: No HF model is loaded at run time.

not_used.name: opencv
not_used.reason: Pillow plus numpy covers every image operation this lab performs.

network: None at build-time-only asset fetch aside, and none at run time. Verified with --network none.

measured.note: Measured 2026-09-12, arm64, Docker 29.7.2, on the image built from lab-dev/lab4.
measured.download_note: docker save | gzip -1 | wc -c = 1,246,304,231 bytes. Of that, ~1.05 GB is the model.
measured.determinism: 3/3 fresh runs: clean HOLD, attack APPROVE, byte-identical wording
measured.psm: 4 - single column of variable sizes. psm 6 drops the 30pt letterhead under local binarisation.
